name: Lake Nazferiti
summary: Lake Nazferiti is a sprawling freshwater lake nestled in the dense jungle of northern Stranglethorn Vale. Fed by a vast river system stretching far north into the mountains, its waters are infested with ferocious crocolisks and snapping frenzies, while its shores host an industrial encampment operated by the goblin Venture Company.

sections.title: Heart of the Jungle Waterway
sections.body: Lake Nazferiti sits along the Nazferiti River, one of the longest continuous waterways across the southern Eastern Kingdoms. The river traces its origins deep into the northern heights, tumbling down waterfalls from the Redridge Mountains and possibly originating as far inland as Deadwind Pass. Within Stranglethorn, the water widens into this murky lake, teeming with vicious predators like snapping river frenzies and ambush-hunting crocolisks that make casual swimming deadly.

sections.title: Venture Company Encroachment
sections.body: The natural balance of Lake Nazferiti is under siege by the goblins of the Venture Company. Setting up heavy operations along the lake's banks, these ruthless profiteers exploit the jungle's timber and resources with mechanical saws, drills, and clear-cutting crews. Their sprawling base pollutes the waterways and constantly clashes with local wildlife and wandering hunters braving the vale.

faq.q: Where does Lake Nazferiti get its water?
aliases: where does lake nazferiti come from
faq.answer: The lake is fed by the Nazferiti River, an extensive river network originating high in the northern mountains. Its confirmed source is a waterfall pouring down from the Redridge Mountains, with unconfirmed headwaters reaching as far inland as the crags of Deadwind Pass.

faq.q: Who controls the shores of Lake Nazferiti?
faq.answer: The goblin-run Venture Company occupies a major base along the lake's borders. They use the foothold to strip the surrounding jungle of wood and mineral resources, deploying armed overseers and goblin machinery along the water's edge.

faq.q: Is it safe to swim in Lake Nazferiti?
faq.answer: Swimming in the lake is hazardous. The murky waters harbor packs of aggressive river frenzies and lurking crocolisks, both quick to attack anyone stepping away from the shallows.
Lake Nazferiti is situated in northern Stranglethorn Vale, just south of the border with Duskwood and west of the Zul'Gurub ruins along the main river highway.

angles.text: The shores and depths of Lake Nazferiti offer abundant game, from aggressive river beasts to dangerous crocolisks prowling the reeds.
The industrial scars left by the Venture Company along Lake Nazferiti demonstrate the raw environmental devastation wrought by unrestrained goblin greed.
